Create CLP treatment database.
```{r}
all_IAPM_treatments <- read_csv(here("outputdata", "all_IAPM_treatments.csv"))


CLP_treatments <- all_IAPM_treatments %>%
 filter(species_code == "CLP") %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date))

#filtering out treatments where we only know the month
CLP_treatments <- CLP_treatments %>%
  # calculate the difference in start date to end date
  mutate(
    days_apart = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, start_date, units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  # 2. Keep only rows where they are 0 or 1 day apart (and drop NAs)
  filter(!is.na(days_apart), days_apart <= 1) %>%
  # 3. Remove the temporary calculation column
  select(-days_apart)
```


Starting with db_sub_pa from 1_Loading and preparing PI data.R. From Jake's Attempt 1 at characterizing treatment histories by PI Survey

```{r}
#load in PI data
db_sub_pa <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/data/db_sub_pa.csv")

#load in lake LZ data, joing LZ acres
MN_lake_basin_littoral_zone <- read_csv(here("data", "MN_lake_basin_littoral_zone_15_ft_std.csv"))
CLP_treatments <- CLP_treatments %>%
  left_join(
    MN_lake_basin_littoral_zone %>% select(DOWLKNUM, LK_LZACRES), 
    by = c("DOW" = "DOWLKNUM")
  )

## Exploring DLNM possibilities ----

dat_dlnm <- db_sub_pa %>%
  filter(!is.na(depth_ft) & depth_ft <= 15) %>%
  mutate(SURVEY_START=as.Date(SURVEY_START),
         year=year(SURVEY_START),
         month=month(SURVEY_START),
         doy=yday(SURVEY_START),
         taxa_rich=rowSums(across(ceratophyllum_demersum:vallisneria_sp)),
         vegetated=ifelse(taxa_rich==0, 0, 1),
         EWM=apply(across(c(myriophyllum_spicatum, myriophyllum_spicatum_x_sibiricum)), MARGIN=1, FUN=max),
         native_rich=rowSums(across(c(ceratophyllum_demersum, 
                                      elodea_canadensis:eleocharis_acicularis,
                                      myriophyllum_sibiricum:potamogeton_robbinsii, 
                                      nitella_sp:potamogeton_strictifolius,
                                      fontinalis_sp:drepanocladus_sp,
                                      nitella_furcata:vallisneria_sp))),
         native_vegetated=ifelse(taxa_rich==0, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(DOW, lake_name, SURVEY_START, year, month, doy) %>%
  summarize_at(vars(ceratophyllum_demersum:vallisneria_sp, taxa_rich:native_vegetated), mean) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(survey_taxa_rich=rowSums(across(ceratophyllum_demersum:vallisneria_sp)>0),
         survey_native_rich=rowSums(across(c(ceratophyllum_demersum, 
                                             elodea_canadensis:eleocharis_acicularis,
                                             myriophyllum_sibiricum:potamogeton_robbinsii, 
                                             nitella_sp:potamogeton_strictifolius,
                                             fontinalis_sp:drepanocladus_sp,
                                             nitella_furcata:vallisneria_sp))>0)) %>%
  drop_na()


#join LZ acres to dat_dlnm

  left_join(
    MN_lake_basin_littoral_zone %>% select(DOWLKNUM, LK_LZACRES), 
    by = c("DOW" = "DOWLKNUM")
  )

# Treatment history: Annual total (APM + IAPM) treatment area
# as a fraction of littoral zone (<=15') area in a lagged matrix for DLNM.
# rows = surveys, columns = lags
# lag0 = treatment in year of survey 
# (includes surveys before and after treatment in the same year, for now)
# lag1 = treatment year before survey
# lag2 = treatment 2 years before survey ...
# lag8 = treatment 8 years before survey ...
# max possible lags is 8 (a 2017 treatment for a 2025 survey?), 
# so that's 9 columns
treatment_history_matrix <- matrix(nrow=dim(dat_dlnm)[1], ncol=9) %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(treatment_history_matrix) <- paste0("lag", 0:8)

target_string <- rep(NA, dim(dat_dlnm)[1])

# populate the matrix
for(i in 1:dim(dat_dlnm)[1]){
  
  if(dat_dlnm$DOW[i]%in%CLP_treatments$DOW){
    
    CLP_treatments_i <- CLP_treatments %>%
      filter(DOW==dat_dlnm$DOW[i])
    
    target_string[i] <- paste(unique(CLP_treatments_i$species_code), collapse=",")
    
    year_i <- dat_dlnm$year[i]
    
    treatment_history_matrix[i, 1] <- ifelse(year_i%in%CLP_treatments_i$treatment_year,
                                               CLP_treatments_i$treatment_size[CLP_treatments_i$treatment_year==year_i]/dat_dlnm$LK_LZACRES[i],
                                             0)
    for(j in 2:9){
      treatment_history_matrix[i, j] <- ifelse((year_i+1-j)%in%CLP_treatments_i$treatment_year,
                                               CLP_treatments_i$treatment_size[CLP_treatments_i$treatment_year==year_i+1-j]/dat_dlnm$LK_LZACRES[i],
                                               0)
    }
    
  } else {
    
    treatment_history_matrix[i, ] <- rep(0, 9)
    target_string[i] <- "none"
    
  }
  
  #print(i)
  
}

head(treatment_history_matrix)
#Code below (commented out) is changing anything that is treatment above 100% of littoral zone to 1 (100)

write.csv(treatment_history_matrix, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/exploration/Treatments x PI Surveys/treatment_history_matrix.csv")
```
